topic: Platform data issues and API stability
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on resolving platform instability, specifically related to data gaps and the ML-API. Initially, there were reports of MQTT server issues (Finnish buses) causing temporary data loss (10-20 minutes). The ML-API was experiencing crashes due to 'Out of Memory' errors. A decision was made to switch from direct API calls for dashboard loading to an asynchronous message queue system to prevent the dashboard from waiting on the unstable ML-API.

Later, a separate issue regarding incorrect frequency requests across all clients via the API was addressed. The team confirmed that dashboards were functioning using default frequencies after this temporary disconnection. Finally, [me] reported that the ML-API frequency issue has been generally fixed in production, though further improvements are needed.
decisions: Switch dashboard data loading from direct ML-API calls to an asynchronous message queue system.
action_items: Follow up on the timeline for fixing high volumes of simultaneous (incorrect) frequency requests and re-enabling service for clients.
